style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust, warm cream-to-butter cream #FDF6E8 and #F7E3B8 for info, variant and CTA screens

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm playful kidswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream white #FDF6E8, butter cream #F7E3B8, warm brown text #8A5A2B and one sky-blue accent #9ED3E8; bright soft warm studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded friendly sans-serif; consistent thin warm-brown line icon style; clean kidswear photography mixed with minimal rounded infographic elements; stable ghost-mannequin garment presentation and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: garment shown ghost-mannequin or neatly folded, stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set
